summary_markdown: A technical issue was discussed regarding an Excel report endpoint (`/api/dashboard/traffic/report-xls`) that functions correctly on staging and production environments but fails when run locally, even with the production database configured. After initial investigation, it was determined that the problem might be local to one of the participants' setup, as a colleague confirmed functionality on their machine, and subsequent testing showed the query working in Datagrip.
action_items: The participant experiencing the error will investigate their local environment configuration.
